description: The sandbox face (machine_face.rs): the app's own copy of the editor, which the workspace window shows when app.intentic.dev cannot be reached, on this computer's own sandboxes. Local content only: no `remote` is set, so the hosted editor the same window shows the rest of the time is granted nothing here, and its one channel into the app stays the intentic:// navigation. The page may ask for this computer's sandboxes with a session the machine minted for each one's owner (the token goes to the page, which talks to that sandbox's daemon on its loopback port with it), for a fresh one when a daemon refused it, and whether the online workspace answers again.
